svg.text: The dashboard v0.1 component tree: LEGO bricks that hand things down
Concepts 5–6 · props flow down from parent to child · events flow up through callbacks · state = a small whiteboard
index.html has <div id="root"> · src/main.tsx mounts <App /> inside it, wrapped in <StrictMode> (effects run twice in development mode)
picks one of three screens with plain state (React Router only comes in Module 24)
loading · not logged in · the logged-in account (GET /auth/me)
message above the form: backend or database down at start, or session expired
page header: the account's name and role
own state: email, password, error, busy
SensorCard: one brick, used many times
Lamp, Fan, the RS-485 trio, and Node 2 use the same mold
props = handed down from parent to child: data (device) or a function (onSelect).
The child only reads what it is given; it never changes it.
events = the child calls that handed-down function, for example onSelect(device);
the parent changes its own state.
state = a small whiteboard owned by one component. It changes through set…,
then React re-renders that component together with its children.
key={view.device.device_id}: another device = a new DeviceDetails, old state dropped.
The same tree shows up in React DevTools, in the Components tab (Practice 2).
